data.prompt:
Fetch the last 24 hours of commits from the GitHub repository OWNER/REPO using web_fetch.

Use this URL (no auth needed for public repos):
https://api.github.com/repos/OWNER/REPO/commits?since=YESTERDAY_ISO8601

Replace OWNER/REPO with the actual repo and YESTERDAY_ISO8601 with the ISO 8601 timestamp for exactly 24 hours ago.

Then post a summary to Discord channel CHANNEL_ID using discord_send_message.

Format the summary like this:
**Daily Commit Summary — OWNER/REPO**
_Last 24 hours (DATE to DATE)_

• `abc1234` — Commit message here (author)
• `def5678` — Another commit message (author)

**Total: N commits**

If there are no commits, post: **Daily Commit Summary — OWNER/REPO** — No commits in the last 24 hours.

IMPORTANT: Replace OWNER/REPO and CHANNEL_ID with the actual values before using this flow.
